question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Abandon
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2**' i.e. **'Constraint'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abandon"** has a couple of different meanings.
 
• **One meaning** is to cease to support or look after (someone); desert.(त्यागना)
 
• **Another meaning,** when used as a noun, is a complete lack of inhibition or restraint.
 
• In this context, the **opposite of "Abandon" **would be:
 
• **Constraint** refers to a limitation or restriction. (बाध्यता)
 
• **It is the state** of being held back or compelled to avoid certain actions. 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Constraint'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the other options:
 
 
• **"Recklessness" -** This term refers to the trait of acting rashly and without caution(लापरवाही).
 
• **"Casualness" - **This term refers to the quality of being relaxed and informal (औपचारिकता).
 
• **"Spontaneity" - **This term refers to the quality of being spontaneous(सहजता).
